items.coder_A: basket_gbm_eligible, uncertain (GBM named only in a measurability rule)
items.reason: GBM is named in the inclusion criteria ("RECIST V1.1 or RANO 2.0 (GBM only)") and GBM-specific exclusion rules exist ("For patients with GBM: less than 12 weeks from the end of previous radiotherapy"), which only make sense if GBM patients can enrol; C7/D27B accept a mention in the inclusion criteria. But the only named cohorts are HCC and G/GEJA, so this is borderline.

Toripalimab is a registered intervention in two experimental arms ("Combination therapy-FS8002 and Toripalimab Injection") but not in the FS-8002-alone arm, and is not described as background, so rule 3 does not apply; it is one of two investigational agents in those arms (rule 5).
